svg.text: Origami for Kids · #06 Fortune Teller · FOLD SHEET · side B
Print BOTH sides (flip on long edge) at 100% / actual size
Side B is the back of the square.
A line that is a valley on one side is a mountain on the other — that is normal!
No double-sided printer? Use only side A; the numbers still show every fold.
Measure: this bar must be exactly 100 mm (print at 100%).
